capabilities: count words, characters, lines, and headings per note
save counts as number-type note properties with custom names
extras: Not yet published in the Community Plugins directory; manual install via GitHub releases. Batch calculations and auto-calculate on save are flagged experimental, with a warning to back up the vault first. Includes donation links (Buy Me a Coffee, GitHub Sponsors).
problem: Obsidian's core word count is transient and per-view, so there is no way to store per-note metrics as queryable properties for dashboards, sorting, and filtering.

relations.evidence: the counts are saved and ready for Dataview or other workflows

summary: Note statistics calculator that counts words, characters, lines, and headings and saves the results as customizable note properties.
